## Enriching lives through innovation

For over 50 years, and in approximately 25 countries, our 6,000 associates have been using science
and ingenuity to create innovations that play a critical role in the everyday lives of many millions
of people.

[About Huntsman][87]

## Markets

### Aerospace and Defense

Improving assembly productivity, reducing weight and extending the lifetime of parts are imperative
to reduce costs in the aerospace and defense sector. As a leading global supplier of
high-performance materials, Huntsman’s products help customers improve production processes, realize
complex designs, reduce weight, and remain compliant with stringent standards and
lower long-term maintenance costs.  

[View Market][88] [View All Markets][89]

### Automation, Robotics and Engineering

Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers and casting machines are used
across many industries to create components and technical parts for a range of applications. In
manufacturing, our materials improve the performance of parts in hydraulic, robotic and conveying
equipment, supporting the growth of smart factories and automation.  

[View Market][90] [View All Markets][91]

### Automotive and Transportation

Huntsman works with leading OEMs and their suppliers to develop effective solutions for the rapidly
changing demands in personal mobility. From the high-performance automobile to mass transit
transportation, Huntsman’s products and materials help the OEM to manufacture vehicles that are safe
and comfortable, with good aesthetics and reduced environmental impact through light-weighting and
improved fuel efficiency.

[View Market][92] [View All Markets][93]

### Building and Construction

Huntsman offers a range of innovative product solutions that improve the efficiency and
sustainability of building, construction and infrastructure projects across the world. Our
energy-saving thermal insulation, coatings and adhesives, composite wood products, thermoplastic
polyurethanes and foams help our customers develop applications for flooring, roofs, walls, facades,
doors, windows, driveways, roads and pipes.

[View Market][94] [View All Markets][95]

### Cold Chain

Huntsman’s MDI-based rigid polyurethane foam plays a critical role in reducing food waste and
extending the life of perishable goods. Our rigid foam provides outstanding thermal insulation
properties, leading to its widespread application throughout the supply chain of perishable goods.

[View Market][96] [View All Markets][97]

### Elastomers

Combining global reach with decades of experience in material innovation, we are experts in
polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane-based (TPU) elastomers and have in-depth knowledge of
their application across a vast range of industries. We have an extensive portfolio of hot and cold
cast elastomers, hot casting machines and TPU elastomers and develop solutions to meet specific
needs.

[View Market][98] [View All Markets][99]

### Electronics & Semiconductors

Huntsman’s innovative solutions are widely used in the electronics industry to protect devices
against chemical, mechanical and electrical loads. We offer a wide range of epoxy and polyurethane
encapsulant chemistries, and our broad industry experience and technical expertise allow us to
address the most stringent requirements for electronics applications.

[View Market][100] [View All Markets][101]

### Energy

The substantial improvement in global living standards in recent decades has created an
increasing demand for diverse, sustainable sources of energy. Used across major energy
sectors, Huntsman’s broad range of products help our customers meet this rising demand through
maximizing safety, production and efficiency, while reducing emissions and costs.

[View Market][102] [View All Markets][103]

### Footwear

Huntsman’s wide and varied range of polyurethane, thermoplastic polyurethane
(TPU) and textile-based solutions help footwear companies get to market faster.  To meet the high
demands and rapidly changing trends in the footwear market, we focus our innovation efforts on
sustainable solutions, automation, customization and smart manufacturing. 

[View Market][104] [View All Markets][105]

### Furniture and Bedding

Huntsman’s MDI and polyols are key ingredients in the production of flexible polyurethane foam, a
highly versatile cushioning material used in furniture, mattresses and pillows. Huntsman works in
close partnership with customers to ensure that consumer needs for comfort are constantly improved.
 Our sustainable textile solutions bring exceptional quality, safety, comfort and durability to home
and institutional textiles.

[View Market][106] [View All Markets][107]

### Industrial

Huntsman materials and solutions are used in several manufacturing industries to enhance the
effectiveness of the end-product. Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers
are used to produce conveyor belts and monolithic belts, cast elastomers, extruded parts and molded
parts.

[View Market][108] [View All Markets][109]

### Sports and Leisure

Huntsman provides a range of market-leading solutions that are used to enhance the comfort,
performance and attractiveness of sports and leisure wear, as well as providing lightweight, strong
and durable materials for sports equipment and athletic shoes.

[View Market][110] [View All Markets][111]

## Product Spotlight

### Huntsman's Battery Materials Portfolio Enables Transition to Electric Vehicles

Huntsman’s battery materials are critical to the reliable operation and long working life of
lithium-ion batteries. These materials also help increase cell capacity by enabling higher
conductivity, thicker cathodes, and higher silicon loading in anodes. The Huntsman battery materials
portfolio can enable emerging technologies such as high silicon anodes, solid state electrolytes,
flexible batteries, and safer aqueous production methods.

[Product Information][112]
[Watch Video][113]

Find the right Huntsman product for you

[Product Finder][114]

## Careers

### Make a difference with us

The ingenuity and commitment of our employees drive innovations across a wide array of markets and
applications, enriching the lives of millions of people across the world. Our people-centered
company offers incredible opportunities for those prepared to take responsibility for their future.

[View Careers][115]

## Sustainability

### Our commitment to sustainability

We see chemistry as a means of solving some of the most pressing societal challenges of our time.
Guided by our support of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals and coupled with care for
our neighbors, we create products and innovations to help meet the world’s growing demands for food,
water, energy and opportunity. Learn about our journey to become a more sustainable business.

[View Sustainability][116]

## Investor Relations

Huntsman Corporation is a publicly traded global manufacturer and marketer of diversified chemical
products with 2025 revenues of approximately $6 billion from our continuing operations. Our chemical
products number in the thousands and are sold worldwide to manufacturers serving a broad and diverse
range of consumer and industrial end markets. We operate more than 55 manufacturing, R&D and
operations facilities in approximately 25 countries and employ approximately 6,000 associates within
our continuing operations. For more information about Huntsman, please visit the company's website
at [www.huntsman.com][117].

## Enriching lives through innovation

For over 50 years, and in approximately 25 countries, our 6,000 associates have been using science
and ingenuity to create innovations that play a critical role in the everyday lives of many millions
of people.

[About Huntsman][87]

## Markets

### Aerospace and Defense

Improving assembly productivity, reducing weight and extending the lifetime of parts are imperative
to reduce costs in the aerospace and defense sector. As a leading global supplier of
high-performance materials, Huntsman’s products help customers improve production processes, realize
complex designs, reduce weight, and remain compliant with stringent standards and
lower long-term maintenance costs.  

[View Market][88] [View All Markets][89]

### Automation, Robotics and Engineering

Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers and casting machines are used
across many industries to create components and technical parts for a range of applications. In
manufacturing, our materials improve the performance of parts in hydraulic, robotic and conveying
equipment, supporting the growth of smart factories and automation.  

[View Market][90] [View All Markets][91]

### Automotive and Transportation

Huntsman works with leading OEMs and their suppliers to develop effective solutions for the rapidly
changing demands in personal mobility. From the high-performance automobile to mass transit
transportation, Huntsman’s products and materials help the OEM to manufacture vehicles that are safe
and comfortable, with good aesthetics and reduced environmental impact through light-weighting and
improved fuel efficiency.

[View Market][92] [View All Markets][93]

### Building and Construction

Huntsman offers a range of innovative product solutions that improve the efficiency and
sustainability of building, construction and infrastructure projects across the world. Our
energy-saving thermal insulation, coatings and adhesives, composite wood products, thermoplastic
polyurethanes and foams help our customers develop applications for flooring, roofs, walls, facades,
doors, windows, driveways, roads and pipes.

[View Market][94] [View All Markets][95]

### Cold Chain

Huntsman’s MDI-based rigid polyurethane foam plays a critical role in reducing food waste and
extending the life of perishable goods. Our rigid foam provides outstanding thermal insulation
properties, leading to its widespread application throughout the supply chain of perishable goods.

[View Market][96] [View All Markets][97]

### Elastomers

Combining global reach with decades of experience in material innovation, we are experts in
polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane-based (TPU) elastomers and have in-depth knowledge of
their application across a vast range of industries. We have an extensive portfolio of hot and cold
cast elastomers, hot casting machines and TPU elastomers and develop solutions to meet specific
needs.

[View Market][98] [View All Markets][99]

### Electronics & Semiconductors

Huntsman’s innovative solutions are widely used in the electronics industry to protect devices
against chemical, mechanical and electrical loads. We offer a wide range of epoxy and polyurethane
encapsulant chemistries, and our broad industry experience and technical expertise allow us to
address the most stringent requirements for electronics applications.

[View Market][100] [View All Markets][101]

### Energy

The substantial improvement in global living standards in recent decades has created an
increasing demand for diverse, sustainable sources of energy. Used across major energy
sectors, Huntsman’s broad range of products help our customers meet this rising demand through
maximizing safety, production and efficiency, while reducing emissions and costs.

[View Market][102] [View All Markets][103]

### Footwear

Huntsman’s wide and varied range of polyurethane, thermoplastic polyurethane
(TPU) and textile-based solutions help footwear companies get to market faster.  To meet the high
demands and rapidly changing trends in the footwear market, we focus our innovation efforts on
sustainable solutions, automation, customization and smart manufacturing. 

[View Market][104] [View All Markets][105]

### Furniture and Bedding

Huntsman’s MDI and polyols are key ingredients in the production of flexible polyurethane foam, a
highly versatile cushioning material used in furniture, mattresses and pillows. Huntsman works in
close partnership with customers to ensure that consumer needs for comfort are constantly improved.
 Our sustainable textile solutions bring exceptional quality, safety, comfort and durability to home
and institutional textiles.

[View Market][106] [View All Markets][107]

### Industrial

Huntsman materials and solutions are used in several manufacturing industries to enhance the
effectiveness of the end-product. Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers
are used to produce conveyor belts and monolithic belts, cast elastomers, extruded parts and molded
parts.

[View Market][108] [View All Markets][109]

### Sports and Leisure

Huntsman provides a range of market-leading solutions that are used to enhance the comfort,
performance and attractiveness of sports and leisure wear, as well as providing lightweight, strong
and durable materials for sports equipment and athletic shoes.

[View Market][110] [View All Markets][111]

## Product Spotlight

### Huntsman's Battery Materials Portfolio Enables Transition to Electric Vehicles

Huntsman’s battery materials are critical to the reliable operation and long working life of
lithium-ion batteries. These materials also help increase cell capacity by enabling higher
conductivity, thicker cathodes, and higher silicon loading in anodes. The Huntsman battery materials
portfolio can enable emerging technologies such as high silicon anodes, solid state electrolytes,
flexible batteries, and safer aqueous production methods.

## Careers

### Make a difference with us

The ingenuity and commitment of our employees drive innovations across a wide array of markets and
applications, enriching the lives of millions of people across the world. Our people-centered
company offers incredible opportunities for those prepared to take responsibility for their future.

[View Careers][115]

## Sustainability

### Our commitment to sustainability

We see chemistry as a means of solving some of the most pressing societal challenges of our time.
Guided by our support of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals and coupled with care for
our neighbors, we create products and innovations to help meet the world’s growing demands for food,
water, energy and opportunity. Learn about our journey to become a more sustainable business.

[View Sustainability][116]

## Investor Relations

Huntsman Corporation is a publicly traded global manufacturer and marketer of diversified chemical
products with 2025 revenues of approximately $6 billion from our continuing operations. Our chemical
products number in the thousands and are sold worldwide to manufacturers serving a broad and diverse
range of consumer and industrial end markets. We operate more than 55 manufacturing, R&D and
operations facilities in approximately 25 countries and employ approximately 6,000 associates within
our continuing operations. For more information about Huntsman, please visit the company's website

# ABOUT SABIC

From making cars and planes more fuel-efficient, to helping conserve the world’s water supply and
enabling colorful smartphone cases, we find solutions to the challenges of today to help our
customers achieve their ambitions and build a better tomorrow.

[OUR INDUSTRIES][177]

## Products

We gain insights by understanding our customers’ needs and use our technical expertise to tailor
solutions to help maximize their market advantage moving forward.

[OUR PRODUCTS][178]

## Sustainability

Sustainability is a vital part of our core business strategy. We're making sure we understand the
megatrends that will impact on our lives in the years to come.

[LATEST SUSTAINABILITY REPORTING][179]
[Two]

## Investors

We’re committed to long-term investments and business partnerships, by harnessing innovation,
learning and operational excellence.

[INVESTORS][180]

## CAREERS

People have helped us to develop, produce and market innovative solutions that make a difference
both to industry and to humanity. At SABIC we enable you to realize your ideas and make an impact.

[VIEW JOB OPPORTUNITIES][181]
[Three people looking at a whiteboard]
[
][182]

## Our Brand

We believe the answer to some of the world's biggest challenges lies in the natural human instinct
to collaborate. Together we're making Chemistry that Matters™.

[Our Brand][183]

## Our Stories

For over 45 years, our ambition to define the future of petrochemicals has yielded solutions for the
challenges of today and helped our customers achieve their ambitions for a better tomorrow. We are
making a meaningful impact in the world and delivering Chemistry that Matters™.

[Read our stories][184]

# ABOUT SABIC

From making cars and planes more fuel-efficient, to helping conserve the world’s water supply and
enabling colorful smartphone cases, we find solutions to the challenges of today to help our
customers achieve their ambitions and build a better tomorrow.

## Our Industries
* [ [agriculture]Agriculture ][168]
* [ [automotice]Automotive ][169]
* [ [Building]Building & Construction ][170]
* [ [Consumer]Consumer ][171]
* [ [Electrical]Electrical & Electronics ][172]
* [ [Healthcare]Hygiene & Healthcare ][173]
* [ [Industrial]Industrial ][174]
* [ [Mass]Mass Transportation ][175]
* [ [Packaging]Packaging ][176]

[OUR INDUSTRIES][177]

[A man holding looking at a tablet screen with a chart]

## Products

We gain insights by understanding our customers’ needs and use our technical expertise to tailor
solutions to help maximize their market advantage moving forward.

[OUR PRODUCTS][178]

## Sustainability

Sustainability is a vital part of our core business strategy. We're making sure we understand the
megatrends that will impact on our lives in the years to come.

[LATEST SUSTAINABILITY REPORTING][179]
[Two]

## Investors

We’re committed to long-term investments and business partnerships, by harnessing innovation,
learning and operational excellence.

[INVESTORS][180]

## CAREERS

People have helped us to develop, produce and market innovative solutions that make a difference
both to industry and to humanity. At SABIC we enable you to realize your ideas and make an impact.

[VIEW JOB OPPORTUNITIES][181]
[Three people looking at a whiteboard]
[
][182]

## Our Brand

We believe the answer to some of the world's biggest challenges lies in the natural human instinct
to collaborate. Together we're making Chemistry that Matters™.

[Our Brand][183]

## Our Stories

For over 45 years, our ambition to define the future of petrochemicals has yielded solutions for the
challenges of today and helped our customers achieve their ambitions for a better tomorrow. We are
making a meaningful impact in the world and delivering Chemistry that Matters™.

[Read our stories][184]

## For Generations

"For Generations" signifies our dedication to acting responsibly today to ensure a positive legacy
for those who come after us. Building on our process expertise and on our core beliefs, this program
is designed to foster trust and create value for Solvay, its stakeholders, and society as a whole. 
[Learn about the program][91]
[AIR Cover_1022x506px - 1]

## Annual Integrated Report

In 2025, Solvay delivered on its commitment to excellence in both financial and sustainability
performance despite a macroeconomic environment marked by geopolitical and  economic uncertainties. 

[Read our latest Annual Report][92]
[Solvay employees in France]

## Join our team and thrive

We actively seek employees whose personal values resonate with ours, as this alignment is integral
to fulfilling our mission. The journey begins with a steadfast commitment to our company’s core
values and purpose. We are essential chemistry, making progress possible for generations.

 

[Discover Life at Solvay][93]

## We are essential chemistry, making progress possible for generations.

Solvay, a pioneering chemical company with a legacy rooted in founder Ernest Solvay's pivotal
innovations in the soda ash process, is dedicated to delivering essential solutions globally through
its workforce of around 9,000 employees. Since 1863, Solvay harnesses the power of chemistry to
create innovative, sustainable solutions that answer the world’s most essential needs such as
purifying the air we breathe and the water we use, preserving our food supplies, protecting our
health and well-being, creating eco-friendly clothing, making the tires of our cars more sustainable
and cleaning and protecting our homes. Solvay’s unwavering commitment drives the transition to a
carbon-neutral future by 2050, underscoring its dedication to sustainability and a fair and just
transition. As a world-leading company with €4.7 billion in underlying net sales in 2024, Solvay is
listed on Euronext Brussels and Paris (SOLB).

purifying the air we breathe and the water we use, preserving our food supplies, protecting our
health and well-being, creating eco-friendly clothing, making the tires of our cars more sustainable
and cleaning and protecting our homes. Solvay’s unwavering commitment drives the transition to a
carbon-neutral future by 2050, underscoring its dedication to sustainability and a fair and just
transition. As a world-leading company with €4.7 billion in underlying net sales in 2024, Solvay is
listed on Euronext Brussels and Paris (SOLB).

## About Us

At Anant Chem, we are driven by Inspired Innovation.
We specialize in the manufacturing of high-performance specialty chemicals and surfactants, designed
to meet the evolving needs of diverse industries such as textiles, detergents, polymers, and water
treatment.

With our state-of-the-art ethoxylation plant, we produce a wide range of ethoxylated surfactants
that ensure superior performance, consistency, and sustainability.
Our focus is on quality, reliability, and innovation, making us a trusted partner for customers
seeking advanced chemical solutions tailored to their requirements.

Backed by years of technical expertise and a deep commitment to environmental responsibility, Anant
Chem continues to develop products that perform better, last longer, and create real value for our
customers.

## Ihre Mitgliedschaft im Composites United e.V.

Rund 350 Mitglieder aus Industrie und angewandter Forschung bilden im Composites United ein starkes,
branchenübergreifendes Netzwerk für faserbasierte Hochleistungsanwendungen. Die Mitgliedschaft
eröffnet Zugang zu wertvollen B2B-Kontakten und gemeinsamen Projekten, stärkt durch gezielte
Öffentlichkeitsarbeit Ihre Sichtbarkeit und bietet Wissenstransfer, vielfältige Bildungsangebote
sowie Unterstützung bei der Erschließung internationaler Märkte.

Verbundwerkstoffe - findet vom 28. bis 29. Oktober 2026 in Bremen statt. Sichern Sie sich jetzt Ihr
Ticket und planen Sie Ihre Beteiligung!

## Who We Are

Esteem is amongst India's leading manufacturer of [Surfactants][14] (also known as surface-active
agents or tensides) and . With over 30 years of experience, we manufacture a comprehensive range of
[Non-Ionic][15], [Anionic][16], Cationic and Amphoteric surfactants. Our surface tension reducing
agents, wetting agents, and emulsifying agents are essential components in various industrial
applications. With a broad spectrum of [chemistries][17] and vast product range (1600+) we meet the
unique requirements of customers and act as a primary supplier for companies, both locally and
internationally.

Under the ownership of Harcros Chemicals Inc, USA, we operate at multiple sites in India, and the
U.S.A. The unique legal entities in India include Esteem Industries Pvt. Ltd. and it's wholly owned
subsidiary Dyna Glycols Pvt. Ltd., besides Grand Organics Pvt. Ltd. and Venus Ethoxyethers Pvt. Ltd.
To cater to the domestic as well as global demand for surfactants and specialty chemical products,
our manufacturing plants in India are strategically located in Goa, Maharashtra and Gujarat. As a
leading chemical manufacturing company, we produce industrial surfactants, specialty chemical
formulations, and custom chemical solutions. With global norms in mind, all our sites are
ISO-9001-2015, ISO-14001-2015, ISO-45001-2018, ISO 20400:2017, ISO-26000:2010, ISO 27001:2022,
ECOVADIS Gold and WASH certified, with a standard SOP firmly in place. Learn more about our
[manufacturing capabilities][18] and [service offerings][19].

These sites are equipped with similar [Ethoxylation][20], [Propoxylation][21], Blending and
[Tolling][22] facilities. With annual capacity exceeding 80,000 MT, Esteem actively operates
multiple reaction vessels with capacities ranging from 100L to 23,000L. These vessels are an
assortment of stainless steel, glass-lined and loop-reactors. Some are also equipped with
distillation facilities. Our chemical processing capabilities include ethoxylation processes,
propoxylation technology, esterification reactions, and custom synthesis services. We serve diverse
industries including [personal care][23], [home care][24], [textile][25], [paper][26], [paint &
coating][27], [agriculture][28], [leather][29], [metal][30], and [oil & gas][31].

## Why Choose Esteem Industries

breakthrough research.

### BROAD PRODUCT RANGE

## Who We Are

Esteem is amongst India's leading manufacturer of [Surfactants][14] (also known as surface-active
agents or tensides) and . With over 30 years of experience, we manufacture a comprehensive range of
[Non-Ionic][15], [Anionic][16], Cationic and Amphoteric surfactants. Our surface tension reducing
agents, wetting agents, and emulsifying agents are essential components in various industrial
applications. With a broad spectrum of [chemistries][17] and vast product range (1600+) we meet the
unique requirements of customers and act as a primary supplier for companies, both locally and
internationally.

Under the ownership of Harcros Chemicals Inc, USA, we operate at multiple sites in India, and the
U.S.A. The unique legal entities in India include Esteem Industries Pvt. Ltd. and it's wholly owned
subsidiary Dyna Glycols Pvt. Ltd., besides Grand Organics Pvt. Ltd. and Venus Ethoxyethers Pvt. Ltd.
To cater to the domestic as well as global demand for surfactants and specialty chemical products,
our manufacturing plants in India are strategically located in Goa, Maharashtra and Gujarat. As a
leading chemical manufacturing company, we produce industrial surfactants, specialty chemical
formulations, and custom chemical solutions. With global norms in mind, all our sites are
ISO-9001-2015, ISO-14001-2015, ISO-45001-2018, ISO 20400:2017, ISO-26000:2010, ISO 27001:2022,
ECOVADIS Gold and WASH certified, with a standard SOP firmly in place. Learn more about our
[manufacturing capabilities][18] and [service offerings][19].

These sites are equipped with similar [Ethoxylation][20], [Propoxylation][21], Blending and
[Tolling][22] facilities. With annual capacity exceeding 80,000 MT, Esteem actively operates
multiple reaction vessels with capacities ranging from 100L to 23,000L. These vessels are an
assortment of stainless steel, glass-lined and loop-reactors. Some are also equipped with
distillation facilities. Our chemical processing capabilities include ethoxylation processes,
propoxylation technology, esterification reactions, and custom synthesis services. We serve diverse
industries including [personal care][23], [home care][24], [textile][25], [paper][26], [paint &
coating][27], [agriculture][28], [leather][29], [metal][30], and [oil & gas][31].

## FAQ. Our answers to frequently asked questions

### Which company is behind Glatt Process Technology Food, Feed & Fine Chemicals?

Glatt Process Technology Food, Feed & Fine Chemicals is a business unit of [**Glatt Ingenieurtechnik
GmbH**][105] and part of the internationally active [**Glatt Group**][106]. For more than 35 years,
Glatt Ingenieurtechnik has been developing innovative process solutions and production systems for
companies in various sectors of the bulk materials industry.

### For which industries are the solutions from Glatt Process Technology Food, Feed & Fine Chemicals
### suitable?

Glatt develops technologies and plants for companies with [applications][107] in the food, feed, and
fine chemicals industries. These include, among others, manufacturers of food, dietary supplements,
animal feed, cosmetics, detergents and cleaning agents, agrochemicals, specialty chemicals, and
high-performance powder materials for technical applications.

### What services does Glatt Process Technology Food, Feed & Fine Chemicals offer?

We support companies from the initial [product idea][108] through to the turnkey [production
plant][109]. Our range of services includes product and process development, scale-up, engineering,
and the construction of complete plants for the production and optimization of powders, granules,
and pellets from solid and liquid raw materials.

### Does Glatt Ingenieurtechnik sell its own bulk material products?

No. Glatt Ingenieurtechnik is a [plant engineering][110] company. We develop technologies and
systems for the production of powders, granules, and pellets from solid and liquid raw materials. As
part of [development project][111]s, we can also produce product samples and pilot batches. For
selected applications, Glatt also offers [contract manufacturing][112] services.

### Can Glatt test new products and processes before an investment is made?

Yes. At the [Glatt Technology Center in Weimar][113], teams from process technology and process
engineering work together with customers to develop and test new products and processes on a
laboratory and pilot scale. This allows for the early verification of technical feasibility, process
reliability, scalability, and investment parameters.

### What makes Glatt Ingenieurtechnik a unique partner?

Glatt Ingenieurtechnik combines [particle technology, process development][114], [plant engineering,
and factory planning][115] under one roof. This reduces coordination efforts, shortens project
timelines, and ensures planning reliability—from the initial concept to successful commissioning.

### How much experience does Glatt Ingenieurtechnik have in process development and plant
### engineering?

Glatt Ingenieurtechnik has more than 35 years of experience, over 5,000 tested products, and more
than 2,500 successfully completed [plant projects][116] worldwide. This expertise forms the
foundation for reliable and cost-effective solutions.

### How can I start a project with Glatt Ingenieurtechnik?

The first step is usually a non-binding discussion about your product, your requirements, and your
goals. Together, we will determine which technology and development path are best suited for your
project.

Glatt Process Technology Food, Feed & Fine Chemicals is a business unit of [**Glatt Ingenieurtechnik
GmbH**][105] and part of the internationally active [**Glatt Group**][106]. For more than 35 years,
Glatt Ingenieurtechnik has been developing innovative process solutions and production systems for
companies in various sectors of the bulk materials industry.

### For which industries are the solutions from Glatt Process Technology Food, Feed & Fine Chemicals
### suitable?

Glatt develops technologies and plants for companies with [applications][107] in the food, feed, and
fine chemicals industries. These include, among others, manufacturers of food, dietary supplements,
animal feed, cosmetics, detergents and cleaning agents, agrochemicals, specialty chemicals, and
high-performance powder materials for technical applications.

### What services does Glatt Process Technology Food, Feed & Fine Chemicals offer?

We support companies from the initial [product idea][108] through to the turnkey [production
plant][109]. Our range of services includes product and process development, scale-up, engineering,
and the construction of complete plants for the production and optimization of powders, granules,
and pellets from solid and liquid raw materials.

### Does Glatt Ingenieurtechnik sell its own bulk material products?

No. Glatt Ingenieurtechnik is a [plant engineering][110] company. We develop technologies and
systems for the production of powders, granules, and pellets from solid and liquid raw materials. As
part of [development project][111]s, we can also produce product samples and pilot batches. For
selected applications, Glatt also offers [contract manufacturing][112] services.

### Can Glatt test new products and processes before an investment is made?

Yes. At the [Glatt Technology Center in Weimar][113], teams from process technology and process
engineering work together with customers to develop and test new products and processes on a
laboratory and pilot scale. This allows for the early verification of technical feasibility, process
reliability, scalability, and investment parameters.

### What makes Glatt Ingenieurtechnik a unique partner?

Glatt Ingenieurtechnik combines [particle technology, process development][114], [plant engineering,
and factory planning][115] under one roof. This reduces coordination efforts, shortens project
timelines, and ensures planning reliability—from the initial concept to successful commissioning.

### How much experience does Glatt Ingenieurtechnik have in process development and plant
### engineering?

Glatt Ingenieurtechnik has more than 35 years of experience, over 5,000 tested products, and more
than 2,500 successfully completed [plant projects][116] worldwide. This expertise forms the
foundation for reliable and cost-effective solutions.

### How can I start a project with Glatt Ingenieurtechnik?

The first step is usually a non-binding discussion about your product, your requirements, and your
goals. Together, we will determine which technology and development path are best suited for your
project.

escalating difficulty provide a compelling challenge for fans of skill-based games.

Baldi’s Basics Plus: Educational and Eerie

Baldi’s Basics Plus creatively blends educational challenges with light-hearted horror. Players
solve math problems and navigate through school-themed levels while avoiding the increasingly
strange behaviors of Baldi. The game’s unique approach to the horror and educational genre makes it
stand out as both entertaining and unnerving.

Night of the Consumers: Retail Horror

Night of the Consumers takes a darkly comedic look at the retail industry by placing players in a
grotesquely exaggerated supermarket where the customers literally are your worst nightmare. This
game is a thrilling survival horror experience with satirical undertones, focusing on the challenges
of customer service.

Yandere AI Girlfriend Simulator: Darkly Romantic

Yandere AI Girlfriend Simulator explores the complexities of a digital relationship with a twist.
Set against a backdrop of obsession, the game challenges players to navigate the affections of an AI
girlfriend whose love can turn dangerously possessive. It’s a psychological thriller that blends
romance, technology, and fear.

[Friday Night Funkin][90]’: Rhythmic Battles

Friday Night Funkin’ revives the rhythm game genre with its vibrant graphics and catchy music.
Players engage in musical battles across a series of weeks, each featuring different opponents and
tracks. The game’s continuous updates and community-driven content keep it fresh and engaging.

The Man from the Window 2: Escalating Terrors

The sequel to the indie hit, The Man from the Window 2, ramps up the suspense as players deal with
the return of the ominous visitor. With more puzzles, storylines, and chilling scenarios, this game
builds on the foundations of its predecessor to offer even more thrills.

Diverse Gaming Genres

Our site celebrates the richness of indie gaming with categories that cater to every type of gamer.
From horror games that set your pulse racing, platformers that challenge your precision, shooters
that test your reflexes, and walking simulators that immerse you in beautiful, thoughtful
environments, our selection is unmatched. Each game is carefully selected to ensure it represents
the innovative spirit of indie gaming.

Explore our curated selection of itch.io’s finest offerings, where each game promises a unique
adventure. Our platform not only brings these games to your fingertips but also fosters a community
of gamers who appreciate the art and craft behind indie game development. Join us to discover new
favorites, challenge yourself with diverse gameplay, and experience the stories that make indie
games a crucial part of the gaming landscape.

Our platform is more than just a place to play games; it’s a vibrant community where gaming culture
thrives and creativity flourishes. We continuously update our collection to include new top sellers
and hidden gems from itch.io, ensuring that you always have access to the best and latest in indie
gaming. Whether you are looking to escape into a narrative-driven adventure, test your skills
against challenging puzzles, or immerse yourself in otherworldly experiences, our collection has
something for everyone.

We invite you to dive into our expansive universe of games, where each click opens up new
possibilities for adventure and challenge. Connect with other players, share your experiences, and
become part of a community that celebrates the diversity and innovation of indie games. Join us
today and transform the way you play and experience games. Explore, enjoy, and escape into the world
of [itch.io’s][91] top sellers, all available right here for convenient online play. Happy gaming!

## Private 
## Label Industrial Detergents

[ See Why We’re #1 ][76]

## Why ITD is the Top Choice for Industrial Detergents
* Customer-Focused Approach
* Professional Manufacturing
* No Direct Sales
* Broad & Growing Product Lines
* Lab Services
* Private Labeling

[ learn more ][77]
[packaging up bottles of product]

## Solutions

ITD has been a formulator and manufacturer of industrial chemical solutions since 1996. We offer a
broad line of stock industrial detergents and other niche chemical products, available under ITD or
private label brands. We also offer custom formulation, blending and packaging to fit the unique
needs of each distributor. ITD moves quickly, keeps you in stock, and hits price points that allow
distributors to compete aggressively in their respective markets. It’s our business to help you
build your chemical program, and together we succeed.

### Stock Chemical
### Products

ITD maintains a broad line of over 250+ stock industrial cleaning products to service distributors
from end to end in a number of market categories.

[ learn more ][78]

### Custom
### Formulation

ITD maintains a professional lab with chemistry talent and instrumentation. If we don’t have it, we
can build it for you.

[ learn more ][79]

### Contract Blending
### & Packaging

From end-to-end “source, blend, package” projects, to any piece in between, ITD can manage the
manufacturing process for your product.
[ learn more ][80]

## Products

ITD maintains a broad line of industrial cleaners to service distributors from end to end in a
number of market categories. With over 250 stock products and hundreds of custom formulations, ITD
has an answer for nearly every industrial cleaning application. Browse our product categories below
and click to view stock products.

# Panjiva Supply Chain Intelligence Data-driven insights for the global trade community

[Plans and Pricing][13] [Request a Demo][14] [Free Newsletter][15]

## The Panjiva Difference

Panjiva is an intelligence platform that’s bringing transparency to global trade through our robust
global coverage, powerful machine-learning technologies, and dynamic data visualizations. Whether
you’re looking to identify potential business partners, keep track of competitors, or find
investment signals, our platform arms you with unrivaled insights to make supply chain decisions
with conviction. [Learn more][16]

## Smart & Intuitive Analytics

Our platform takes the power of **machine learning** and **data visualization** to give you clear,
actionable insights on global trade.

[Watch Demo][17]

## Find and evaluate legitimate businesses, faster

### 9 million companies and over 2 billion shipment records, just a few seconds away

#### Search for Importers and Exports

Our technology gives you immediate insight into the companies involved at every node of
international supply chains. From manufacturers and buyers to shipping and logistics, Panjiva allows
customers to better understand trade around the globe.

#### Take the data with you

Building a lead list for your sales team? Easily export the results and share them with your team to
expand their reach.

[[Screenshot-supplier-search-for-shirts]][18]
[Supplier Search for shirts]

#### Search your way

Whether you are searching for a product by name or classification, we make it easy. We support
commodity name, HS / HTS code, *D-U-N-S® Number*, and location-based searches.

#### Receive periodic email alerts

Save your search and receive email alerts anytime a new company matches your search criteria, or
when an existing company has new shipment activity.

## A Clear View of Each Company’s Activities

### Information and insights from authoritative customs and business information databases melded
### together to give a 360 degree view of businesses worldwide.

[[An example Panjiva Profile]][19]
[An example Panjiva Profile]

#### Actionable Insights

Powerful reporting capabilities let you spot trends in the import and export activities businesses
across the globe.

#### Top Customers & Suppliers

Discover new opportunities by seeing who does business with your peers or competitors.

#### Contact Information

Access the emails or phone numbers of key decision makers on over 1 million companies.

## A Comprehensive View of Global Trade

### We provide our clients with transactional data covering 35% of global trade flows.
### Armed with this data, you can decide where and when to invest.

#### Competitive Insights

Understand your market share by seeing where your competitors source their goods, and which entities
are involved in the shipment of goods.

#### Risk Analysis

Use our [platform][20] to analyze trade lanes or identify which companies have the riskiest supply
chains.

#### Sales Leads

Whether you’re targeting buyers, suppliers, NVOCCs, or carriers, Panjiva makes it easy to identify
the best sales prospects, learn more about their business, and make contact.

#### Xpressfeed™ Access Available

Use [Xpressfeed™][21] to push leads directly into your CRM system or feed data about publicly-traded
companies into your quant models.

[[Screenshot-network-view-diagram]][22]

### From Supply Chain Research

[[2026-07-17-sce-involution-600x370]][23]

##### [Supply Chain Edge: Evolving involution, forecasting transport prices, sourcing Ukraine’s
##### electronics][24]

July 17, 2026

– Mainland China’s anti-involution campaign is set to remain a supply chain policy priority even as
producer prices return to inflation, with the focus shifting from broad capacity cuts to demand
repair, investment discipline and higher returns on capital. The US removal of de minimis...

[More research articles ][25]

## Robust global coverage. Powerful machine learning technologies. Dynamic data visualizations.
## Surge ahead of the competition with Panjiva Supply Chain Intelligence.

About us

Raha Group is a global market leader in the supply of premium petroleum and petrochemical products,
committed to delivering exceptional products and services to industries worldwide. Established in
2014, we have grown into a dynamic organization with a talented team of professionals dedicated to
excellence.

With offices strategically located in Turkey and the UAE, Raha Group leverages strong connections to
renowned refineries and factories in the Middle East. This strategic positioning enables us to
supply a diverse range of petroleum derivatives and petrochemical products to customers across the
globe.

We are an authorized vendor of several well-known refineries in the Middle East, supplying various
types of petroleum derivatives and petrochemical products to our worldwide customers. We are also a
manufacturer and exporter of industrial, cosmetic, and pharmaceutical grades of paraffin wax, liquid
paraffin, and petroleum jelly. These capabilities allow us to offer a diverse portfolio of products
supporting a wide range of industries.

Raha Group is equipped with strong infrastructure, a team of skilled professionals, and cutting-edge
technologies. We also offer a variety of third-party inspection services and flexible payment
methods to facilitate the financial side of business.

With a distinguished legacy of conducting business in over 40 countries, Raha Group is committed to
delivering excellence through innovative solutions and trusted partnerships. Our global reach and
expertise enable us to meet the diverse needs of our clients while fostering sustainable growth and
building lasting relationships worldwide.

**OUR MISSION:**

We aim to set global benchmarks in quality and service by expanding opportunities, building
resilient relationships, and ensuring the highest level of customer satisfaction. Raha Group's
mission is to provide you with a wide range of products from trusted manufacturers, refineries, and
petrochemical producers.

**OUR VISION:**

To be a globally trusted name in the energy sector, pioneering advancements that shape the future of
industrial performance and sustainability. For this reason, we have become one of the leading
suppliers of various commodities at fair prices for our customers.

**OUR CUSTOMERS:**

The wide business scope of Raha Group's products has earned the company customers from all over the
world. We export a significant share of the world's best-produced bitumen, gilsonite, and paraffin,
offering reasonable prices, specialized packaging, and fast delivery. If you are a consumer of
bitumen, gilsonite, paraffin, or lubricants, our team is ready to assist you.

**INFRASTRUCTURE:**

Strong infrastructure is one of the most important factors in the bitumen, gilsonite, paraffin, and
lubricant industry, giving customers greater confidence and reliability when purchasing from this
company. As one of the largest suppliers of these products from Iran, Raha Group has consistently
been able to supply the best-quality samples to customers and consumers worldwide.

About us

Raha Group is a global market leader in the supply of premium petroleum and petrochemical products,
committed to delivering exceptional products and services to industries worldwide. Established in
2014, we have grown into a dynamic organization with a talented team of professionals dedicated to
excellence.

With offices strategically located in Turkey and the UAE, Raha Group leverages strong connections to
renowned refineries and factories in the Middle East. This strategic positioning enables us to
supply a diverse range of petroleum derivatives and petrochemical products to customers across the
globe.

We are an authorized vendor of several well-known refineries in the Middle East, supplying various
types of petroleum derivatives and petrochemical products to our worldwide customers. We are also a
manufacturer and exporter of industrial, cosmetic, and pharmaceutical grades of paraffin wax, liquid
paraffin, and petroleum jelly. These capabilities allow us to offer a diverse portfolio of products
supporting a wide range of industries.

Raha Group is equipped with strong infrastructure, a team of skilled professionals, and cutting-edge
technologies. We also offer a variety of third-party inspection services and flexible payment
methods to facilitate the financial side of business.

With a distinguished legacy of conducting business in over 40 countries, Raha Group is committed to
delivering excellence through innovative solutions and trusted partnerships. Our global reach and
expertise enable us to meet the diverse needs of our clients while fostering sustainable growth and
building lasting relationships worldwide.

**OUR MISSION:**

We aim to set global benchmarks in quality and service by expanding opportunities, building
resilient relationships, and ensuring the highest level of customer satisfaction. Raha Group's
mission is to provide you with a wide range of products from trusted manufacturers, refineries, and
petrochemical producers.

**OUR VISION:**

To be a globally trusted name in the energy sector, pioneering advancements that shape the future of
industrial performance and sustainability. For this reason, we have become one of the leading
suppliers of various commodities at fair prices for our customers.

**OUR CUSTOMERS:**

The wide business scope of Raha Group's products has earned the company customers from all over the
world. We export a significant share of the world's best-produced bitumen, gilsonite, and paraffin,
offering reasonable prices, specialized packaging, and fast delivery. If you are a consumer of
bitumen, gilsonite, paraffin, or lubricants, our team is ready to assist you.

**INFRASTRUCTURE:**

Strong infrastructure is one of the most important factors in the bitumen, gilsonite, paraffin, and
lubricant industry, giving customers greater confidence and reliability when purchasing from this
company. As one of the largest suppliers of these products from Iran, Raha Group has consistently
been able to supply the best-quality samples to customers and consumers worldwide.

### [Silicone Oil][41]

#### Silicone Oil

Shengqing Materials, a renowned manufacturer in the industry, offers a wide range of silicone oil
solutions, including transparent type, water soluble type and silicone emulsion. Silicone oil, as
known as silicone fluids, is a versatile ingredient in personal care products, has gained immense
popularity for its exceptional properties.

One of the key advantages of silicone oil lies in its transparency, making it an ideal choice for
various cosmetic formulations. Shengqing Materials' transparent silicone oil enhances the appearance
and texture of products, giving them a luxurious feel and impeccable clarity. This ingredient is
widely used in skincare, haircare, and makeup products, delivering exceptional performance and
desired results.

Shengqing Materials' silicone emulsion offers another innovative solution for personal care
formulations. This emulsion combines the benefits of silicone oil with the ease of application
provided by water-based products. The result is a lightweight and non-greasy formula that spreads
easily and absorbs quickly into the skin. Silicone emulsions from Shengqing Materials provide
long-lasting moisturization and nourishment, leaving the skin feeling silky smooth and supple.

Overall, Shengqing Materials is able to provide silicone oil, even silicone specialty as per
clients’ varied demands.Products are ensured to meet the highest standards, providing consumers with
reliable options for their personal care needs.

### [Cosmetic Emulsifiers][42]

#### Cosmetic Emulsifiers

As professional manufacturers and suppliers of high quality cosmetic emulsifiers products in China,
Shengqing Materials is committed to delivering excellence to our customers. We supply cosmetic
emulsifiers and provide formula support and reasonable price to ensure you'll be competitive in the
market, while giving priority to product safety and environmental protection issues.We provide a
comprehensive price list for our Emulsifier Agent.

An emulsifier agent is a vital ingredient in various formulations, particularly in the cold process
method, where high temperatures are not used. These substances facilitate the mixing of water and
oil, creating stable emulsions essential for products like lotions, creams, and sauces. A
high-efficiency emulsifier ensures that the ingredients blend seamlessly, resulting in a smooth,
uniform texture. Safety is paramount, so choosing emulsifier agents that are non-toxic and
skin-friendly is crucial, especially for cosmetic applications. By utilizing an efficient
emulsifying agent in cold processes, manufacturers can enhance product quality while maintaining
safety and effectiveness, catering to consumers' needs.

example, they can be used in personal care items like facial cleansers and body wash, or they can be
used in household cleaners like all-purpose cleaners and glass cleaners.Additionally, it can also be
used in industrial applications like metalworking and oil drilling.

One of the advantages of using mild surfactants like those offered by Shengqing Materials is that
they are gentle on human skin. This is because they do not strip away the natural oils on our skin,

### [Silicone Oil][41]

#### Silicone Oil

Shengqing Materials, a renowned manufacturer in the industry, offers a wide range of silicone oil
solutions, including transparent type, water soluble type and silicone emulsion. Silicone oil, as
known as silicone fluids, is a versatile ingredient in personal care products, has gained immense
popularity for its exceptional properties.

One of the key advantages of silicone oil lies in its transparency, making it an ideal choice for
various cosmetic formulations. Shengqing Materials' transparent silicone oil enhances the appearance
and texture of products, giving them a luxurious feel and impeccable clarity. This ingredient is
widely used in skincare, haircare, and makeup products, delivering exceptional performance and
desired results.

Shengqing Materials' silicone emulsion offers another innovative solution for personal care
formulations. This emulsion combines the benefits of silicone oil with the ease of application
provided by water-based products. The result is a lightweight and non-greasy formula that spreads
easily and absorbs quickly into the skin. Silicone emulsions from Shengqing Materials provide
long-lasting moisturization and nourishment, leaving the skin feeling silky smooth and supple.

Overall, Shengqing Materials is able to provide silicone oil, even silicone specialty as per
clients’ varied demands.Products are ensured to meet the highest standards, providing consumers with
reliable options for their personal care needs.

### [Cosmetic Emulsifiers][42]

#### Cosmetic Emulsifiers

As professional manufacturers and suppliers of high quality cosmetic emulsifiers products in China,
Shengqing Materials is committed to delivering excellence to our customers. We supply cosmetic
emulsifiers and provide formula support and reasonable price to ensure you'll be competitive in the
market, while giving priority to product safety and environmental protection issues.We provide a
comprehensive price list for our Emulsifier Agent.

An emulsifier agent is a vital ingredient in various formulations, particularly in the cold process
method, where high temperatures are not used. These substances facilitate the mixing of water and
oil, creating stable emulsions essential for products like lotions, creams, and sauces. A
high-efficiency emulsifier ensures that the ingredients blend seamlessly, resulting in a smooth,
uniform texture. Safety is paramount, so choosing emulsifier agents that are non-toxic and
skin-friendly is crucial, especially for cosmetic applications. By utilizing an efficient
emulsifying agent in cold processes, manufacturers can enhance product quality while maintaining
safety and effectiveness, catering to consumers' needs.

### [Mild Surfactant][43]

#### Mild Surfactant

Shengqing Materials provides a range of products that can be used in various applications. For
example, they can be used in personal care items like facial cleansers and body wash, or they can be
used in household cleaners like all-purpose cleaners and glass cleaners.Additionally, it can also be
used in industrial applications like metalworking and oil drilling.

One of the advantages of using mild surfactants like those offered by Shengqing Materials is that
they are gentle on human skin. This is because they do not strip away the natural oils on our skin,
which helps to prevent dryness and irritation. In fact, many people with sensitive skin find that
switching to mild surfactant products has improved their skin health.

Overall, mild surfactants are a highly effective and eco-friendly choice for a wide range of
applications. Whether you're looking for a cleaning product for your home or a surfactant for an
industrial application, choosing a mild surfactant like those offered by Shengqing Materials is a
smart choice for both the environment and your well-being.

### [Thickening Agent][44]

#### Thickening Agent

Thickening agent, also called thickener or rheology modifier, is widely used in personal care or
home care formula to adjust viscosity to reach ideal product performance. Customers in most
countries believe high viscosity stands for good quality, low viscosity without thickening agent's
synergy will be deemed as low quality as it performs close to water.

ShengQing Materials is a professional thickener producer that thickening stability and thickening
efficiency are most important factors during its application. Besides, it is necessary to pay
attention to the clarity after adopting thickening agent. What's further, more and more clients are
caring about the natural index of thickener nowadays to be less harmful to human being.

## Deliverables That Drive Revenue Decisions

Research outputs designed to plug directly into planning, investment and board level discussions.

### From Insight to Implementation

#### Data Collection

sources.

#### Analytics and Modelling

indicators.

#### Insight Development

Senior analysts translate findings into clear storylines and strategic implications.

#### Actionable Deliverables

Concrete recommendations, prioritised actions and quantified impact ranges.

#### Follow Through and Measurement

Support in defining KPIs and tracking how decisions influence revenue, margin and risk over time.

## Your Trusted Partner in Market and Revenue Intelligence

Strategic Revenue Insights is part of SRI Consulting Group Ltd and focuses on one thing: helping
organisations make better revenue decisions.

We give strategy, finance and business leaders a common, fact-based view of the markets they operate
in. This reduces debate about “what is true” and shifts the conversation to “what should we do
next”.

### Stronger Investment and Portfolio Choices

By linking market outlooks to product, geography and customer portfolios, we help you decide where
to expand, where to hold and where to exit. The result is sharper focus and better use of capital.

Clear evidence and simple narratives make it easier to align leadership teams, secure stakeholder
buy in and move at speed. Our team remains available beyond the report handover to test assumptions
and refine plans.

surface treatment. Following the agreement between BASF and Carlyle, we have become an independent,

long-standing customer relationships, trusted heritage brands, and a culture shaped over more than

decision-making and agility, backed by Carlyle's global network and commitment to our growth.

## Over 130 years of expertise. A new beginning.

We are Surventis - formerly known as BASF Coatings - a global leader in automotive coatings and
surface treatment. Following the agreement between BASF and Carlyle, we have become an independent,
standalone company: a new identity, built on continuity.

Our new chapter builds on the foundations that have made us strong: deep technical expertise,
long-standing customer relationships, trusted heritage brands, and a culture shaped over more than
130 years. As an independent company, we now move with greater entrepreneurial freedom, faster
decision-making and agility, backed by Carlyle's global network and commitment to our growth.

Our intelligent coatings help customers shine in their markets. We anticipate global trends and
identify opportunities that shape the future of industries. We meet the highest technical and
quality demands in an aesthetically pleasing, environmentally friendly way, combining design with
functionality. Our work in research, production and service is reliable worldwide.

### Driven by passion and science

Built on BASF's heritage with a more entrepreneurial future, we foster an inspiring exchange across
diverse perspectives.

other industries. Working with us means going further to solve even your most challenging needs.

[
Image

We support the coil industry with surface treatment and advanced application technologies that
prepare and protect metal before it is shaped and coated.
[Learn more][72]
[

### Specialty

From a perfectly smooth piano finish to precise optical components and durable motorcycle surfaces,
we help each surface perform as intended in its own context.

### Trusted heritage brands

Behind Surventis stands a portfolio of brands the industry has relied on for generations. Glasurit®,
with over 130 years of refinish expertise, and R-M®, with more than a century of color leadership,
are recognized by bodyshops and manufacturers worldwide, alongside specialist brands like baslac®
and Norbin®. These names carry a legacy of quality that continues into our new chapter.

### [ Surventis launches as an independent global leader in automotive coatings and surface
### treatment ][84]

MUENSTER, Germany, July 1, 2026. Surventis, formerly BASF Coatings, today launched as an independent
company, completing its carve-out from BASF. With around €3.9 billion in annual sales and around
10,700 employees, Surventis is one of the world’s leading suppliers of automotive coatings and
surface treatment solutions. The business is majority-owned by funds managed by global investment
firm Carlyle (NASDAQ: CG) in partnership with Qatar Investment Authority. BASF holds a 40% stake in
Surventis.
Jul 1, 2026

executives with proven records in finance, digital and transformation. The Executive Committee will

## Завод по Литью пластика на ТПА

Литье пластмассовых изделий занимает в мире важную отрасль современной промышленности. Это
высокотехнологический процесс, способствующий созданию типовых деталей, их заготовок методом
заливания расплавленного сырья в соответствующую полость. Таким образом воспроизводятся необходимые
габариты пластмассового изделия.

Литье пластмасс позволяет производить всевозможные изделия, используемые повсеместно - в быту, в
офисах, в медучреждениях, в строительстве. Кажущаяся простота деталей, изделий не означает, что
процесс их производства– простейшая работа.Для пластмассового литья предприятию на самом деле
необходимы современное оборудование, квалифицированные специалисты, большой производственный опыт.

Специализированные компании предлагают потребителям бесконечный перечень продукции, получаемой путем
литья пластмасс: посуду, игрушки, корпусы светильников, предметы интерьера, ручки, дюбеля, вешалки,
тары различной емкости и пр. Среди поставщиков пластмассовой продукции «Завод Пластмасса»,
предоставляющий услуги по литью пластмассовых изделий.

## Процесс литья

Производство пластмассовой продукции осуществляется на термопластавтоматах. Перерабатывая
термопласты, пресс-форма термостатируется. Происходит разогрев до температуры отверждения для
переработки реактопластов в окончательное изделие.

На давление действуют вязкость расплава пластмассы, сама пресс-формы, размер будущей продукции.
Литье пластмассовых изделий под давлением дает большой диапазон по размерам изготовляемых изделий -
от десятиграммовых до нескольких килограммов.

Выбор термопластавтомата обусловлен объем пластмассы для отливки,смыкающим усилием, удерживающим
пресс-формы под давлением. Повышение давления при литье пластмассовых деталей происходит постепенно
и распределяется неравномерно из-за высокой вязкости пластмассы.

• Проектирование изделия из пластмассы;
• Планирование пресс-форм,

## Завод по Литью пластика на ТПА

Литье пластмассовых изделий занимает в мире важную отрасль современной промышленности. Это
высокотехнологический процесс, способствующий созданию типовых деталей, их заготовок методом
заливания расплавленного сырья в соответствующую полость. Таким образом воспроизводятся необходимые
габариты пластмассового изделия.

Литье пластмасс позволяет производить всевозможные изделия, используемые повсеместно - в быту, в
офисах, в медучреждениях, в строительстве. Кажущаяся простота деталей, изделий не означает, что
процесс их производства– простейшая работа.Для пластмассового литья предприятию на самом деле
необходимы современное оборудование, квалифицированные специалисты, большой производственный опыт.

Специализированные компании предлагают потребителям бесконечный перечень продукции, получаемой путем
литья пластмасс: посуду, игрушки, корпусы светильников, предметы интерьера, ручки, дюбеля, вешалки,
тары различной емкости и пр. Среди поставщиков пластмассовой продукции «Завод Пластмасса»,
предоставляющий услуги по литью пластмассовых изделий.

## Процесс литья

Производство пластмассовой продукции осуществляется на термопластавтоматах. Перерабатывая
термопласты, пресс-форма термостатируется. Происходит разогрев до температуры отверждения для
переработки реактопластов в окончательное изделие.

На давление действуют вязкость расплава пластмассы, сама пресс-формы, размер будущей продукции.
Литье пластмассовых изделий под давлением дает большой диапазон по размерам изготовляемых изделий -
от десятиграммовых до нескольких килограммов.

Выбор термопластавтомата обусловлен объем пластмассы для отливки,смыкающим усилием, удерживающим
пресс-формы под давлением. Повышение давления при литье пластмассовых деталей происходит постепенно
и распределяется неравномерно из-за высокой вязкости пластмассы.

## Этапы изготовления изделия

• Оформление заявки с предоставлением образцов;
• Проектирование изделия из пластмассы;
• Планирование пресс-форм,
